property_summary: For any non-empty _tos/v arrays, C.transfer(...) returns true when all external calls succeed; the mutant returns false instead, so there exist inputs where the reference returns true but the mutant returns false.

For every non-empty _tos/_v array and a callee that always succeeds, C.transfer(...) returns true (reference) while the mutant returns false for those same inputs, so the rule is: when all external calls succeed and _tos.length>0, transfer(...) must return true — the mutant violates this by returning false for some inputs.
For any non-empty _tos and matching v arrays where all external calls to caddress succeed, C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for such inputs, violating this rule.
For any non-empty _tos array where every low-level call to the provided caddress succeeds, C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant instead returns false for some such inputs, breaking that rule.
